lens: How would I break this? Did a test actually walk the breaking path? Is there a failing fixture proving the lane catches the violation? Do all branches have at least one test, or only the happy path?
answer: The combined v4+v5 plan declares 24+6=30 acceptance rows and 49+18=67 grit units but is materially under-tested at the adversarial level given this is a CC-1 kernel_public_api change. Of the eight critical attack surfaces named in the brief, only three are walked by an explicit test row (torn-write via crash_injection.rs 34a-c, hung-CLI via watchdog_kill_p95 33d, poison-loop via quarantine_after_3 33e). The remaining five surfaces — dead_letter-without-peek_lock, peek_lock TTL race with commit, settings-drift mid-render, projected_tokens_p95 underestimate, and multi-account silent-switch under mid-flight degradation — have NO test row anywhere in §B.12 or §C. The v4-patch-#6 InboxStore::dead_letter atomic contract declares 'Calling on an unlocked message returns StoreError::InvalidTransition' (§B.2.3 doc-comment) yet ZERO test row exercises this error branch — the contract is asserted in prose only. v5 introduces a brand-new kernel public-API (SettingsRenderer trait + 12 value types) and a brand-new CI lane (lean-settings-drift) but enumerates ONLY passing fixtures (codex.toml, claude.toml, gemini.toml + scaffold-time-captured codex-hooks.observed.json, gemini-cli-help.observed.txt). NO failing fixture is enumerated for: (a) HookEventNotMapped error path; (b) SecretRefUnresolved error path; (c) DriftState::Extra detection; (d) InvalidTemplate parser error; (e) UnsupportedFormat. The capability-seed conformance protocol (build.rs writes T-tier; tests read same file in same invocation) is a structural hand-typed-pass-evidence risk: if build.rs spawns a mock instead of a real CLI subprocess, the conformance test passes vacuously — identical pattern to the TG2 finding where check_rust_default_language always returned NotYetArmed. v5 §C.21 uses cost_ceiling=100 vs projected=500 (5x ratio) — a test designed to pass; an adversarial fixture would walk the boundary (101/100, 100/100, 99/100). v5 §C.28 mtime-equality is a tests-designed-to-pass smell because tempfile+rename on Linux preserves mtime only when the renderer explicitly cp's atimes/mtimes, which is not declared.
key_claims: InboxStore::dead_letter atomic contract (v4 patch #6) declares StoreError::InvalidTransition on unlocked-message call but ZERO test row in §B.12 exercises this branch. The kernel public-API contract is asserted in prose only.

peek_lock TTL expiry race with commit is structurally possible (B.4 step 1 uses TTL=30s; B.3 says expired-TTL locks released by recover()) but NO test row walks the race: thread A holds lock past TTL, thread B peek_locks, thread A returns and commits — outcome is undefined by the plan and untested.

Multi-account silent-switch is the FOUNDATIONAL user-intent requirement ('multiple accounts. and across multiple providers') yet check_silent_switch (B.4 step 6) has NO adversarial test row. A mid-flight account degradation between snapshot (step 2) and commit (step 16) is not walked.

v5 introduces a new kernel public-API (SettingsRenderer trait at §B.2.2) — CC-1 — and declares failing_fixture_added=FALSE de facto: no row in §B.7 grit units v5.1..v5.18 enumerates a failing fixture for any of the 5 SettingsRendererError variants (Io, UnsupportedFormat, HookEventNotMapped, SecretRefUnresolved, InvalidTemplate).

lean-settings-drift CI lane (v5 §B.5) declares passing fixtures only. NO failing fixture row exists demonstrating the lane catches a real drift, a missing secret-ref, or a hook-event vocabulary mismatch. F3 spec evidence_required for new lane sub-checks = failing_fixture_added TRUE; this plan satisfies that with FALSE.
DriftState enum (§B.2.1) has 4 variants (Match, Modified, Missing, Extra) but only C.27 walks Modified. NO test row exercises Missing or Extra. C.27 alone is happy-path-for-detection.

Conformance build.rs writes T-tier into seed; conformance test reads same file in same invocation (v3 diff #7). If build.rs spawns a mock that hard-codes 'T1', the test passes vacuously — same anti-pattern as TG2 check_naming_convention with a synthetic workspace lacking any bad filename. No row asserts build.rs invokes a REAL CLI subprocess.

C.21 (ceiling=100 vs projected=500) is a tests-designed-to-pass smell — the 5x ratio makes the comparator trivially satisfied. The boundary case (projected=100, projected=101) is the adversarial probe and not enumerated.

projected_tokens_p95 source (C.19, row 33g) walks ONLY the cold-start seed semantic (n<10 falls back to cost_ceiling). The adversarial path — warm window where p95 underestimates a tail-burst actual — is unwalked. A cost-ceiling bypass through p95 underestimation is structurally enabled.

Hung-CLI test (33d watchdog_kill_p95) walks kill latency only. NO test row asserts: (a) FDs return to baseline after watchdog kill (FD leak attack surface); (b) the in-flight message produces exactly one SpendRecord, not zero or two (credit double-charge attack surface).

Settings drift mid-render is structurally unwalked. CodexRenderer materializes BOTH ~/.codex/config.toml and ~/.codex/hooks.json (§B.3 v5). tempfile+rename(2) is atomic per-file but NOT atomic across two files. SIGKILL between the two renames leaves Codex in a half-rendered state. NO test row covers this.

Concurrent VerifyMode::AutoReconcile races are unwalked. Two tick_once calls hitting AutoReconcile on the same account both call render() concurrently. The 'idempotent' claim (B.2.2 doc, C.28) is asserted by mtime equality on serial invocation only, not under concurrency.

Inbox torn-write test (34a test_sigkill_during_outbox_rename) walks single-writer SIGKILL only. Concurrent producers writing to the same inbox directory (the literal attack surface named by the brief — 'concurrent producer crash mid-rename') is not enumerated.

v5 §B.6 R1/R2 declare fixtures captured AT SCALE-TIME by cp from local ~/.codex/hooks.json and gemini --help. These are PASSING fixtures of observed reality. They cannot prove HookEvent::Stop → 'subagent-stop' mapping fails if a future Codex release renames the event; no synthetic failing fixture is enumerated.

Settings template parser (parse_template_toml, grit unit v5.14) is hand-rolled (no serde). Adversarial TOML inputs — duplicate [[hooks]] keys, unterminated string literals, deeply nested arrays, mixed-tab-indentation — are not enumerated as test fixtures. SettingsRendererError::InvalidTemplate is unreachable by any declared test.
uncertainty_areas: Whether 34a test_sigkill_during_outbox_rename is a single-writer test or a concurrent-producer test — the row name suggests single, but the underlying lane is lean-fsync-durability which could be either; if single-writer-only, the brief's named attack surface is unwalked.
Whether 33g projected_tokens_p95_source walks only the seed (n<10 fallback) or also tail-distribution adversarial inputs. C.19 wording focuses on the seed case.
Whether the conformance build.rs spawns a real CLI subprocess to measure T-tier (legitimate) or mocks it (hand-typed-pass-evidence). The plan does not declare which.

Whether tempfile+rename in v5 CodexRenderer guarantees ordering between config.toml-rename and hooks.json-rename (it does not under POSIX — two renames are independent operations). The 'atomic' claim in §B.2.2 doc may be misleading for the dual-file Codex case.
Whether v5 C.28 mtime-equality check is meaningful — POSIX rename(2) updates ctime not mtime on the destination if it pre-existed, so the check may pass for the wrong reason.

Whether check_silent_switch is invoked AFTER step 16 commit, or only at step 6 (snapshot time). If only at step 6, an account degraded between step 6 and step 14 spawn still routes to the degraded account — race unwalked.

Whether the v4 lifecycle test 33b test_restart_replays_from_cursor verifies the cursor advances only after successful outbox.append (B.3 fsync ordering), or just that it advances. If the latter, a crash between commit and outbox.append re-replays a duplicate message.
diagnostic_asserted: The plan introduces a NEW CC-1 kernel public-API (SettingsRenderer trait + 12 value types) AND a NEW CI lane (lean-settings-drift) but enumerates ZERO failing fixtures. F3 spec evidence_required: failing_fixture_added MUST be TRUE for new lane sub-checks AND new kernel public-API; this plan satisfies neither. Additionally, the v4-patch-#6 dead_letter atomic contract is declared in prose-only with no test row exercising the StoreError::InvalidTransition branch. Of the 8 critical attack surfaces enumerated by the team-lead brief, only 3 (torn-write, hung-CLI watchdog kill latency, poison-loop quarantine count) have explicit test rows; the remaining 5 are unwalked.
attack_surfaces_named: Inbox JSONL torn-write under CONCURRENT producer crash mid-rename (brief item 1) — not single-writer SIGKILL which 34a covers
Hung CLI subprocess with FD leak across watchdog kill (brief item 2) — 33d covers kill latency, not FD baseline
Hung CLI subprocess with subscription credit double-charge (brief item 2) — no SpendRecord uniqueness assertion
Poison-message restart loop that EXCEEDS MAX_PARSE_RETRIES=3 before quarantine fires (brief item 3) — 33e asserts at 3 but not >3 bound
InboxStore::dead_letter called WITHOUT prior peek_lock (brief item 4) — atomic contract per v4 patch #6 declares InvalidTransition; no test row
peek_lock TTL=30s expiry RACE with commit (brief item 5) — no test row
Settings drift mid-render: templates/foundry-supervisor/codex.toml changes WHILE CodexRenderer is mid-rename (brief item 6) — no test row
Settings drift mid-render: CodexRenderer SIGKILL between config.toml-rename and hooks.json-rename leaves Codex half-rendered (brief item 6, dual-file Codex case) — no test row
projected_tokens_p95 underestimates actual tail-burst tokens (brief item 7) — only seed source (C.19) tested, not warm-window underestimate
Multi-account silent-switch when account-A degrades BETWEEN snapshot (step 2) and spawn (step 14) (brief item 8) — no test row exercises mid-flight degradation
v5 NEW: HookEvent vocabulary mismatch — HookEvent::Stop maps to Codex 'subagent-stop' which doesn't exist in observed hooks.json — should yield HookEventNotMapped; no failing fixture
v5 NEW: SecretReference unresolved at spawn — sref://openbao/foundry/mcp-gateway/token returns Err — should yield SecretRefUnresolved; no test row
v5 NEW: DriftState::Extra — stray ~/.claude/extra.json not in manifest — should report Extra; no test row exercises this variant
v5 NEW: Concurrent AutoReconcile race — two tick_once calls both call render() on the same drifted account; no test row asserts idempotence under concurrency
v5 NEW: Hand-rolled parse_template_toml fed adversarial inputs (duplicate keys, unterminated strings, mixed indentation) — should yield InvalidTemplate; no failing fixture
Conformance build.rs writes T-tier the test reads — circular if build.rs mocks the CLI spawn; no row asserts the spawn is real
break_paths_walked: Torn write under SINGLE-writer SIGKILL during outbox rename: WALKED by grit unit 34a test_sigkill_during_outbox_rename (lifecycle.rs).
Torn write under SINGLE-writer SIGKILL during lock write: WALKED by 34b.
Torn write under SINGLE-writer SIGKILL during commit unlink: WALKED by 34c.
Torn write under CONCURRENT producer crash mid-rename: NOT WALKED — no test row covers multi-writer.
Hung CLI watchdog kill latency p95 ≤ 5s: WALKED by 33d test_watchdog_kill_p95.
Hung CLI FD leak across kill: NOT WALKED — no test row asserts FD baseline pre/post.
Hung CLI credit double-charge: NOT WALKED — no test row asserts exactly-one SpendRecord per kill.
Poison message quarantine at exactly 3 retries with tier demote: WALKED by 33e test_poison_message_quarantine_after_3 (acceptance C.7).
Poison message MAX_PARSE_RETRIES bound (assert NOT >3): NOT WALKED — count==3 asserted; >3 unbounded.
dead_letter called on unlocked message returns InvalidTransition: NOT WALKED — v4 patch #6 contract is prose-only.
dead_letter called on locked message atomically consumes lock: NOT WALKED — only C.21 walks the cost-ceiling path; no row asserts the atomic semantics on poison path.
peek_lock TTL expiry then commit: NOT WALKED.
peek_lock TTL expiry then second peek_lock acquires (two-writer same-message): NOT WALKED.

Cost-ceiling bypass via projected_tokens_p95 underestimate of tail burst: NOT WALKED. C.21 uses 100/500 (trivially differentiable); the boundary case 99/100, 100/100, 101/100 is unwalked; the warm-window underestimate (n>=10, p95 << actual) is unwalked.
projected_tokens_p95 cold-start seed = cost_ceiling: WALKED by 33g (C.19).
Multi-account silent-switch with same-tick A and B candidates: WALKED implicitly by step 6 check_silent_switch but NO explicit test row enumerates the adversarial case.
Multi-account silent-switch with account-A degraded BETWEEN snapshot and spawn: NOT WALKED.
Multi-account silent-switch with two providers locked simultaneously: NOT WALKED.
Settings drift Modified detection: WALKED by C.27.
Settings drift Missing detection: NOT WALKED — DriftState::Missing has no acceptance row.
Settings drift Extra detection: NOT WALKED — DriftState::Extra has no acceptance row.
Settings re-render idempotence under SERIAL invocation (mtime check): WALKED by C.28.
Settings re-render idempotence under CONCURRENT invocation: NOT WALKED.
CodexRenderer dual-file atomicity (config.toml + hooks.json under SIGKILL between renames): NOT WALKED.
Settings template parser InvalidTemplate on duplicate keys / malformed TOML: NOT WALKED — no failing fixture in v5 §B.7.
HookEventNotMapped error on a HookEvent variant a provider's mapping table doesn't carry: NOT WALKED — no failing fixture; only the round-trip-totality happy path is implied at §A.1.4 (a).
SecretRefUnresolved error at spawn when sref:// fails to resolve through OpenBaoAdapter: NOT WALKED — no test row exercises this error branch.
No-raw-secrets grep over rendered output: WALKED by C.29 (grep -RFq exit 1).
Conformance build.rs measures REAL CLI subprocess output (not mocked): NOT WALKED — no row asserts the measurement is non-mocked.
Settings drift mid-render under concurrent template mutation: NOT WALKED.
Cedar fragment coverage gate (v3 diff #1 C.24): WALKED by row 21 (cedar fragment-coverage).
fixuptasks: F-DEAD-LETTER-INVALID-TRANSITION: Add tests/lifecycle.rs::dead_letter_on_unlocked_returns_invalid_transition exercising v4-patch-#6 contract. ASSERT: inbox.dead_letter(id, reason) on a never-locked message returns Err(StoreError::InvalidTransition). New grit unit. Failing fixture: an unlocked MessageId.

F-PEEK-LOCK-TTL-RACE: Add tests/lifecycle.rs::peek_lock_ttl_expiry_then_commit_walks_race. Thread A peek_lock with TTL=1s; sleep 2s past TTL; Thread B peek_lock acquires; Thread A commit must return InvalidTransition. Adds a state-machine row to InboxState transitions.

F-SILENT-SWITCH-MIDFLIGHT: Add tests/lifecycle.rs::silent_switch_caught_when_account_degrades_between_snapshot_and_spawn. Fixture: snapshot returns [A,B]; A degrades; step 4 routes to B; assert check_silent_switch fires at the correct boundary (before step 14 spawn).

F-COST-CEILING-BOUNDARY: Add tests/lifecycle.rs::cost_ceiling_at_boundary parametric test with (projected, ceiling) in {(99,100), (100,100), (101,100), (1,1), (0,0)}. Current C.21 5x-ratio is tests-designed-to-pass; add a boundary table.

F-PROJECTED-P95-UNDERESTIMATE: Add tests/lifecycle.rs::projected_p95_warm_window_underestimate_does_not_bypass_ceiling. Feed a tail-burst sample distribution where p95=50 but actual=500; assert post-spawn UsageBlocked OR window correction emits an audit event. Currently 33g covers cold-start only.

F-WATCHDOG-FD-BASELINE: Add tests/lifecycle.rs::watchdog_kill_returns_fds_to_baseline. Capture FD count before spawn, after watchdog kill; assert delta == 0 within tolerance. Addresses FD-leak attack surface.

F-WATCHDOG-NO-DOUBLE-CHARGE: Add tests/lifecycle.rs::hung_cli_emits_exactly_one_spend_record_after_kill. Assert SpendRecord uniqueness per ticket post-watchdog. Addresses credit double-charge attack surface.

F-CONCURRENT-INBOX-RENAME: Add tests/crash_injection.rs::test_sigkill_during_concurrent_producer_rename. Two writers SIGKILL'd at different points; recovery must yield zero torn lines. Addresses brief's verbatim 'concurrent producer crash mid-rename'.

F-DRIFT-MISSING: Add C.27.bis acceptance row + tests/drift_detection.rs::missing_file_reports_drift_state_missing. delete a rendered file; verify() must return DriftEntry { state: DriftState::Missing }.

F-DRIFT-EXTRA: Add C.27.ter acceptance row + tests/drift_detection.rs::stray_file_in_render_root_reports_drift_state_extra. Add an unmanaged file to render root; verify() must return DriftEntry { state: DriftState::Extra }.

F-HOOKEVENT-FAILING-FIXTURE: Add crates/oya-intelligence-settings-template-adapter-fs/tests/fixtures/codex-hooks.invalid.json (FAILING fixture: declares a HookEvent variant not in CodexRenderer's mapping table). Add tests/hook_event_mapping.rs::unknown_event_yields_hook_event_not_mapped. Satisfies F3 evidence_required failing_fixture_added=TRUE for the new SettingsRenderer kernel API.

F-SECRET-REF-UNRESOLVED-FIXTURE: Add registry/accounts/codex.unresolved-sref.example.toml (FAILING fixture: sref:// pointing to non-existent OpenBao path). Add tests/secret_ref_resolution.rs::unresolved_sref_returns_secret_ref_unresolved_error. Failing fixture for lean-settings-drift CI lane.

F-TEMPLATE-PARSER-FAILING-FIXTURE: Add tests/fixtures/templates/{duplicate-keys,unterminated-string,mixed-indent}.toml (FAILING fixtures). Add tests/parse_template_toml.rs::adversarial_inputs_yield_invalid_template. Exercises SettingsRendererError::InvalidTemplate branch — currently unreachable.

F-CODEX-DUAL-FILE-ATOMICITY: Add tests/render_atomicity.rs::sigkill_between_codex_config_toml_and_hooks_json_renames_leaves_consistent_state. SIGKILL CodexRenderer between rename(config.toml.tmp -> config.toml) and rename(hooks.json.tmp -> hooks.json). Verify recovery semantic: either both renamed or both reverted. Currently dual-file atomicity is undeclared.

F-CONCURRENT-AUTORECONCILE: Add tests/concurrent_reconcile.rs::two_auto_reconcile_snapshots_one_render_each_account. Two parallel tick_once with VerifyMode::AutoReconcile on the same drifted account; assert renderer is idempotent under concurrency and exactly one final manifest matches.

F-CONFORMANCE-NO-MOCK: Add row to §B.5 + §C.12.tris: 'Conformance build.rs invokes a REAL CLI subprocess (claude, codex, gemini binaries on $PATH). Assertion: build.rs invocation under OYA_CONFORMANCE_MOCK=1 must produce a DIFFERENT autonomy_tier than under unset; mock detection fails the gate.' Closes hand-typed-pass-evidence loophole.

F-CHANGE-CLASS-DECLARATION: Append change_class declaration to v5 frontmatter: 'change_class: CC-1 (kernel_public_api — new SettingsRenderer trait + 12 value types). evidence_required: failing_fixture_added=TRUE.' Without this, the existing change-class enforcement lane cannot detect the v5 escalation.
F-POISON-LOOP-UPPER-BOUND: Strengthen 33e: assert quarantine fires at EXACTLY 3 retries, not >=3. Inject 5 poison reads and assert spawn count = 3, not 5. Closes the unbounded-retry edge.

F-SETTINGS-DRIFT-MIDRENDER: Add tests/render_atomicity.rs::template_mutated_during_render_does_not_produce_torn_output. Mutate templates/foundry-supervisor/codex.toml AFTER renderer reads it but BEFORE rename. Assert rendered output matches the template version-at-read, not version-at-rename.
